8180.title: CLI read waterfalls and duplicate environment lookup
8180.rootCauseOneLine: Serial awaits delay independent CLI/SDK reads; thread JSON bypasses the display helper's environment read and fetches the environment twice.

prReviews.topFinding: Targets the verified paths; PR code was not executed. Review failure handling when reads overlap.

8180.proposedFix: Overlap independent reads while preserving failure handling, and reuse one environment read. Existing open PR #8181 prevents a duplicate fix PR.
8180.caveats: Synthetic HTTP reproduction, repeated by the same agent in a second clean checkout. Live-server timings and PR runtime behavior were not verified. Complete probe is inline under report-repository policy.
